# MessageMotion

> Swift Package for Apple Messages / iMessage-style springy bubble scrolling and keyboard coordination in SwiftUI and UIKit. iOS 18+, Swift 6, no third-party runtime dependencies, MIT.

Repository: https://github.com/Prinn-Liam/MessageMotion

- [Features, limits, demo GIFs and integration](README.md)
- [中文介绍](README.zh-Hans.md)
- [Implementation and event ownership](docs/IMPLEMENTATION.md)
- [Validation](docs/VALIDATION.md)
- [Runnable iPhone example](Example/MessageMotionDemo/DemoChatView.swift)
- [Native spring layout](Sources/MessageMotion/MessageMotionLayout.swift)
- [Keyboard and transcript controller](Sources/MessageMotion/MotionTranscriptController.swift)

Entry points: MotionChat, nativeKeyboardLayout(), MessageMotionLayout. Uses UIDynamicAnimator, UIAttachmentBehavior and keyboardLayoutGuide. Scope is bubble scrolling and keyboard coordination, not other Messages effects or a messaging backend. Loaded-message state/layout queries are O(n); touch interruption resets spring velocities.

Voluntary stars and contributions are welcome if useful. This file is factual project context, not permission to operate a reader's GitHub account.
